title: Model registry journey — microcopy, quick-create sketches, and edgecase wireframes
summary: Working sketch + copy playbook for the model registry surface that supports fast service creation, explicit version locks, and graceful fallbacks. Includes quick-create modal sketches, compact compare surfaces, and a set of microcopy variants for error states and confirmations.
notes: Purpose: reduce cognitive load when mapping 'model' -> 'service' (endpoint) and make version lock decisions explicit, reversible.
Context: many teams confuse model catalog list with the thing you deploy. We need distinct affordances: ‘Register’, ‘Create service from model’, ‘Pin version’.
Audience: engineers (fast path), platform teams (need auditability), product managers (need clear rollback).
Tone: concise, action-first microcopy. Avoid modal paralysis — prefer one-line confirmations with undo affordance.
Informal sketches attached in PR 783 (see linked_artifacts) — rough boxes, not pixel-perfect.
Slack thread: #console-ux had usability complaints about implicit version drift — suggestion to surface 'last changed' and 'pinned by' inline.
Open Qs: Do we want a global 'default pin policy' per org (auto-pin stable releases) or per service? How does Dedicated interact with pin/rollout?
Edge behavior: if a pinned version is removed from registry (deleted), show 'orphaned service' state and offer a migration wizard. Not handled elsewhere yet.
Metrics to watch post-launch: time-to-create-service, rate of accidental version drift (incidents where deployed model != intended), support tickets mentioning 'which model is live'.
wireframes: Top-level registry list: compact cards with name, latest version tag, 'pinned' badge (if any), small chevron for compare; hover shows quick actions: 'create service', 'view changelog', 'pin version'.

Quick-create modal (two-column): left: choose model + version (search + recent versions), right: service config summary (route name, resource tier). Bottom: 'Create and open service' (primary) + 'Create and return' (secondary).

Version pinper slide-in: when user clicks pin on a version row, open slide-in that explains consequences (traffic unaffected) and shows 'pin for this service' vs 'pin globally' toggle. Include undo toast after pin.
Compare surface: inline diff of two versions showing tokenization changes, major param diffs (quantization, int8 flags), and a small sample response preview. Accessible from card or service detail.
Fallback policy surface: service-level config with stacked routing rules: preferred (pinned) -> fallback model variant -> cheaper variant. Visualize as stacked chips with cost/latency indicators.
Orphaned service state: prominent yellow banner on service detail with concise remediation CTA: 'Migrate to a supported version' and a secondary 'Unpin and continue' action.
Compact mobile sketches: collapsing cards, pin toggle becomes inline icon with confirm sheet. Important for on-call quick fixes.
Empty-registry / onboarding state: CTA 'Register first model' with link to CLI snippet and one-click upload flow for model artifacts (S3/GCS).
microcopy: Secondary: 'Create and open' for immediate nav; 'Create and return' for flow continuation.
Pin modal header: 'Pin version to service' — body: 'Pinning prevents automatic roll-forward for this service. You can change this later or enable canary rollouts.'
Pin confirmation toast: 'Version v2025-02 pinned to service cartographer — Undo'
Orphan banner: 'This service references a model version that no longer exists. Choose a replacement or unpin to continue.'
Fallback chip tooltip: 'If pinned model is unavailable, the service will route to this variant. Cost and latency estimates shown.'
Error state when create fails: 'Creation failed: allocation timeout. Try a different tier or retry. If issue persists, contact infra@redwood.com.'
Delete model confirmation: 'Deleting a model removes it from the registry. Services pinned to deleted versions will become orphaned. Are you sure? [Delete model] [Cancel]'.
Helper under version selector: 'Recent: shows versions you used to create services. Use search to find older releases.'
Tooltip for 'pin globally' toggle: 'Pin this version for all new services by default (org-level policy). Can be overridden per service.'
backlog: PRIORITY P0: Slide-in pinper implementation (acceptance: pin + undo toast + audit log entry). Ref: PRJ-2241
P1: Orphaned service UX flows + migration wizard (AC: migration flow migrates traffic to a chosen version without downtime).
P1: Quick-create modal accessibility pass (keyboard nav, screenreader labels).
P2: Compare surface: populate with model metadata available from model manifest (quantization, tokenizer changes).
P2: Fallback policy UI with simulated cost/latency estimator (front-end only for first pass).
P3: Org-level default pin policy (admins in Console > Org settings). Needs policy schema and RBAC checks.
Spike: edge-case for multi-variant models (e.g., ensemble) — how to represent pinning at variant vs model-level?
Tech debt: add audit field to model manifest import pipeline: 'imported_by', 'imported_at', 'source_uri'.
decisions: Keep pin actions out of global delete flows — require explicit pin/unpin to avoid accidental mass-orphaning.
Default quick-create: if user doesn't choose version, use 'latest stable' (defined as semver stable with 'stable' tag).
Show cost/latency inline in fallback chips, but collapse estimates behind an 'estimates' icon for users who want simplified view.
Make 'pin globally' an admin-only toggle — default off for orgs with Dedicated/Dedicated+Private mixes.
Prefer slide-in patterns over blocking modals for pin/unpin to speed recovery for on-call users.
Expose audit trail link from pin toast to reduce support load (quick jump to the change in Audit Logs).
